title: Sunset Sail Along the San Diego Skyline
includes: Food and snacks are not offered. Guests are welcome to bring any food and drinks you'd like (not included)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Each person regardless of age MUST have a ticket due to strict Coast Guard regulations. This includes infants of any age. Extra person's regardless of age that arrive and put us over our passenger limit will be denied boarding.
policies: Refunds will not be issued if tour/activity is missed due to late or non-arrival of cruise ship or flight.
Our office hours are 12pm until the sunset sail departure. Leave a voice or text message outside of those hours and we will get back to you.
Be sure to follow the link under "Special Instructions" on your Viator ticket after booking for a detailed map, photos, directions & video of our meeting point.
We sail as scheduled in the event of light rain.
We are located at Safeharbor Sunroad Marina, 945 Harbor Island Dr. San Diego, CA 92109. We will meet at Gate 1 Docks A-D

We cannot guarantee seperate reservations will be on the same boat due to strict coast guard capacity safety rules. to ensure your entire party sails together, only make 1 reservation for your entire group.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy an evening sailing under the sunset on a relaxing sailing cruise with a unique perspective on San Diego that you can only get from the water.  Our San Diego Bay Sunset Sailing Cruises provide an up-close and personal view of the scenic waterfront architecture, military crafts, historical ship's and landmarks, local sea life and spectacular photo opportunities.
